subject: prd/implement-now
statement: When a configured task proposal is verified genuinely green, the executor shall atomically capture the exact verified head revision into one durable review obligation before emitting the implementation terminal, then release that task's implementation claim and dispatcher width slot and admit the obligation to the review frontier without waiting for the implementation sweep to finish; no later proposal-head lookup may change the obligation's revision, and inability to persist or recover it shall still release both resources, preserve the succeeded implementation truth, and fail the run as review infrastructure.
rationale: per-task capture removes the sweep-long drift window and delayed outcomes without allowing review latency to consume implementation capacity
fit_criterion: an ordering trace proves green verification → exact-revision obligation persistence → succeeded EVT-10 → claim/width release → review launch for each task; concurrent head movement after green never changes the reviewed revision; crash points at every edge recover one obligation, release both resources, and never redispatch implementation
